info.name: Docusign Creates a connect configuration for the specified account.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The external account number (int) or account id GUID.

items.docs: Creates a DocuSign Custom Connect definition for your account. DocuSign Connect enables the sending of real-time data updates to external applications. These updates are generated by user transactions as the envelope progresses through actions to completion. The Connect Service provides updated information about the status of these transactions and returns updates that include the actual content of document form fields. Be aware that, these updates might or might not include the document itself.

info.name: Docusign Returns users from the configured Connect service.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The external account number (int) or account id GUID.

params.name: connectId
params.description: The ID of the custom Connect configuration being accessed.

params.name: count
params.description: Optional. Number of items to return.

params.name: email_substring
params.description: Filters the returned user records by the email address or a sub-string of email address.

params.name: start_position
params.description: The position within the total result set from which to start returning values. The value **thumbnail** may be used to return the page image.

params.name: status
params.description:
Filters the results by user status.
You can specify a comma-separated
list of the following statuses:

* ActivationRequired 
* ActivationSent 
* Active
* Closed 
* Disabled

params.name: user_name_substring
params.description: Filters the user records returned by the user name or a sub-string of user name.

items.docs: Returns users from the configured Connect service.
